Each dict has fields: domain, ip_address, last_resolved, first_seen, last_seen, reputation, last_analysis_stats, last_analysis_results.

We need to output the result in JSON format. The user didn't specify a particular format beyond "in JSON format". So we can just output the entire response as JSON. But we might want to format it nicely. The instructions say: "When responding to the user, do not mention the tool usage or the function name." So we should not mention that we used get_dns_info. Just output the JSON. Also we should not mention the function name. So we just output the JSON. The function will return a dict. We'll output that dict as JSON. That is straightforward.
